_about: Which earlier-script (legacy) results the dashboard uses (analysis/legacy.py). Benches map to workloads: gemm -> C1, saxpy -> B1, gemv (sparse rows) -> B3 SpMV, spgemm -> B4, gemv (dense rows) -> GEMV (extra page, not one of the 16). 'use' marks a bench as correct for a device (white tick); false = it ran but the method was wrong (red TODO). 'why' is shown to readers: keep it plain English. Devices that already have final-script data ignore their legacy data. Row filters applied to every bench: status == ok; GEMM 2:4 'sparse' rows dropped (the density setting was ignored and they use TF32 tensor cores).

caveats.gemm: Earlier script: average of 10-20 timed runs; only some sizes were checked against a reference.
caveats.saxpy: Earlier script: average of 20 timed runs.
caveats.gemv: Earlier script: average of 15 timed runs.
caveats.spmv: Earlier script: average of 15 timed runs; results were never checked against a reference.
caveats.spgemm: Earlier script: average of 10 timed runs; results were never checked against a reference; failed sizes are left out.

why_not.saxpy: Every size fitted in the on-chip cache, so it never measured memory speed (up to 235% of the memory limit).

study_invalid.C2: The study computed the closed-form option-price formula instead of simulating random paths.
study_invalid.C8: The study's GPU encryption kernel was a placeholder, not real AES.
study_invalid.C3: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.
study_invalid.C4: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.
study_invalid.C6: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.
study_invalid.C7: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.
study_invalid.S1: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.
study_invalid.A1: Ran only inside the separate GH200 memory-placement study: no reference check and a different timing method.

drop_reasons.bf16: This GPU has no bf16 hardware, so those results were emulated.
drop_reasons.fp64t: This GPU has no fp64 tensor cores; those rows were ordinary fp64.
drop_reasons.gemv_dense_max_size: Small sizes fitted in the on-chip cache (above the memory limit).
drop_reasons.power: The earlier CPU power readings were wrong, so power and energy are not shown.
